_doc: Per-texture tag overrides for tools/make_tag_table.py, keyed by an inventory id or a unique prefix of one (6+ chars).
Each value may set 'cls' (a class name from classes.json) and any of the 7 parameters: scale, strength, rough, wear,
tint, a, b (their meaning per class: the snippet's '// @param' lines). Unset parameters keep the class defaults.
A class worker puts their rows in tools/materials/overrides/<class>.json (same layout) instead, so parallel work
never edits the same file; this file is for cross-class fixes. A texture may appear in only one of them.
decision_fixes maps a mistyped id in the inventory's class decisions to the texture it meant (checked by hand
against the decision's description and the texture's name).
